packageRules.description: stable/* are maintenance branches: patch updates only.
Do not raise routine major-update PRs. Renovate's vulnerability remediation bypasses packageRules by design, so a major is still raised when it is the lowest version that fixes a known vulnerability.
Auto-merge minor and patch updates once CI is green.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Vulnerability fixes are user-facing: commit them as fix(deps) and auto-merge once the required checks are green. The fix commit marks the change for the next patch release, but merging it does not publish anything by itself: this repo releases only from a manual SemVer tag push (see .github/workflows/release.yml), so a maintainer still has to tag to ship the fix. Renovate appends this as the last package rule, so it overrides the chore commit type and the automerge/enabled rules above.
